name: Hung Curd Cucumber and Chana Bowl
ingredients: 200 g plain low-fat Greek yogurt or hung curd
steps: Whisk yogurt until smooth with lemon juice, cumin, pepper and salt.
Pat chickpeas dry and toss with a little cumin and chopped herbs.
Divide yogurt between two bowls. Top with chickpeas, cucumber and carrot.
Sprinkle with pumpkin seeds and remaining herbs.
Serve chilled. Keep refrigerated until serving.
note: Vegetarian, not vegan. Use plain unsweetened yogurt; protein content varies significantly between Greek-yogurt brands.
